releases.title: Sources you can open
highlights: Every growth calculation now shows its sources: tap “Sources” next to a percentile, target-height range, bone-age reading or nutrition target to see the WHO, Dietary Reference Intake and clinical references behind it.
A new Medical information & sources library lives under Account → Support & legal, with the educational-use limitations in one place.
Clearer message if Sign in with Apple can’t complete, so you always have a next step.

releases.title: Lab results, made clear
highlights: Your lab results come alive: each value shows a clear range bar, a trend with a gentle projection, and a plain-language line on what it means.
Tap any result for the full picture — reference range, 12-month trend, what it means, and Evidence & References to the research behind it.
IGF-1, vitamin D, ferritin, TSH and hemoglobin get a focused, parent-friendly treatment; if your report prints an SDS (z-score), add it to see it on an age & sex-adjusted scale.
An AI reading across all five growth labs together, with questions you can bring to your doctor (available where AI features are offered).
New accounts are gently guided to set up their first child before anything else.

releases.title: Remove a child profile
highlights: You can now remove a child profile from the app. It's archived, not deleted — hidden but recoverable for a year (longer on Pro), with all logged data kept during that time.
You'll always keep at least one active profile.

releases.title: Iron and vitamin D on Analytics
highlights: Analytics now shows two more growth co-factors — iron and vitamin D — captured automatically from the foods you already log.
See a 30-day average against your child's age target, without any extra tapping on the Today page.
Vitamin D from food is naturally low, so the card counts your child's outdoor days as the bigger source instead of raising an alarm.

releases.title: Smarter food logging
highlights: Add your own foods — a favourite brand, a home recipe, a supplement — and edit or remove them anytime. Find them fast under the new ⭐ Mine tab.
The food list now learns you: foods you log often rise to the top.
New deli & sausage foods (ham, bologna, hot dog, and more) with a ⚠ Salty flag so you can see the sodium trade-off at a glance.
Search the activity list, and a quick note explaining why GrowSense tracks protein rather than every calorie.

releases.title: The logging calendar
highlights: Tap the date on Today to open a month calendar of your logging — every day shows nutrition, activity and sleep at a glance, with a bar for how close each got to its target.
Days that still need you are outlined in gold — "Fill next" walks through them oldest-first.
Tap any day to see where its numbers came from; one "Looks right" confirms all of that day's estimates together.
The calendar now speaks all six app languages, with Thai weekday and month names.

releases.title: Small refinements
highlights: Account now shows how you signed in — Google, Apple, or email — so you always know which one you used.

releases.title: First production release
highlights: Never lose a day — the recall engine rebuilds missed nutrition, activity, and sleep days from your child's own patterns, always marked as estimates.
Trust calendar — see exactly which days are measured vs estimated, and confirm or correct any of them.
Smarter analytics — week-over-week deltas, trend direction, a growth chart with a habit-scenario band, and a research-weighted readiness score personalized to your child.
Pediatric visit summary PDF — a clean, printable report for your doctor (available where offered).
Sign in with Google or Apple, plus password reset.
